description: This line plot illustrates the relationship between the number of reasoning steps and the Pass@1 rate for two different configurations, one of which is identified as GPT-4o while the other's label is redacted. The x-axis is labeled "Num. of Reasoning Steps" and features a non-linear scale with discrete, equally spaced tick marks at values of 5, 10, 20, and 40. The y-axis is labeled "Pass@1 Rate (%)" and uses a linear scale ranging from 0 to 100, with tick labels spaced at regular intervals of 20. The plot contains two solid lines that both exhibit an upward trend across the x-axis. The first line, representing GPT-4o, is dark blue with solid circular markers; it starts at a value of 6.5 at 5 steps, rises to 32.3 at 10 steps, climbs to 77.4 at 20 steps, and ends at 83.9 at 40 steps. The second line, corresponding to the redacted legend entry, is light blue with 'x' cross markers; it begins at 19.4 at 5 steps, increases to 38.7 at 10 steps, rises to 87.1 at 20 steps, and concludes at 89.2 at 40 steps.
